summary: Week two of a brand-new account, and it was quiet: 11 messages total, with the last client message on Aug 8. The week opened with Kaitlynn posting three photos she immediately unsent, then asking who her account manager is — Ollie Mckinlay answered within a minute ('Myself'). She then said she was 'taking notes this week' and would circle back while the team settled in, and has not posted since. On the ALTR side the week was actually productive: Mica Vecco introduced herself as Social Media Director with a booking link (Aug 11), and Ollie set up and shared a Google Drive for wall posts (Aug 11 ask, link delivered Aug 13). Two things are still open going into the Aug 19 new-content drop: Kaitlynn's Aug 7 offer to record an 'I'm back' voice memo/video is still unanswered by ALTR after a full week, and Ollie's wall-post upload request has now been made twice with no client reply. The Invoicing topic thread has still had zero messages since the group was created — no billing terms, invoice, or payment has been discussed with this new client at all.

health.rationale: Down from 92 last week. No complaints and no service failures — but the honeymoon energy cooled (client silent since Aug 8), her Aug 7 voice-memo question is still unanswered by ALTR after 7 days, ALTR has had to chase her twice for wall posts, and the Invoicing thread remains completely empty two weeks into the account with the Aug 19 drop approaching.
